info.name: AppLovin Axon Campaign Management Ad Units Revenue Reporting API

params.name: api_key
params.description: Report Key (issued under Account > Keys in the Axon dashboard).

params.name: columns
params.description: Comma-separated list of report columns to return.

params.name: start
params.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD. Must fall within a 45-day request window with end.

params.name: end
params.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD. Must fall within a 45-day request window with start.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination.

params.name: not_zero
params.description: Set to 1 to exclude rows where all metrics are zero.

items.docs:
Retrieve aggregated MAX revenue and user-level metrics for a publisher
account. Specify the columns you want returned plus a date range
(start, end) within a rolling 45-day window. Optional filters, sort,
limit, and offset support customised reporting and pagination.
